name: Dalbit
cover:
Still hunting
for the right
sleep sound?

features.label: The usual way
features.headline:
An hour of
scrolling sounds
features.text:
Rain, then waves, then rain again.
None of them feels quite like yours.

features.label: Layer it
features.headline:
Rain below,
water drops above
features.text:
Stack rain, water drops, birdsong
and singing bowls into one sound.

features.label: Tune each layer
features.headline:
Volume, rhythm
and space
features.text:
Set how loud each layer is, how often it plays
and where you hear it.

features.label: Bonus
features.headline:
Save it once.
One tap after that
features.text:
Name your mix and it waits in your library.
Tomorrow night, just tap the moon.

outro:
Your sleep sound,
made by you
points: Keeps playing with the screen off
Sleep timer fades out, never cuts
